task.title: Require pods to run on specific nodes using requiredDuringScheduling node affinity
task.shortdesc: Configure hard node selection so a pod is scheduled only onto nodes that match required node labels.

step.cmd: Choose the node label key and value that represent the required placement (for example, "workload-tier=critical").
Verify candidate nodes have the label by running "kubectl get nodes --show-labels" and checking the key/value.
Edit the Pod or workload manifest and add "spec.affinity.nodeAffinity.requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution".
Under "nodeSelectorTerms", add a "matchExpressions" entry with "key", "operator: In", and the allowed "values".
Apply the manifest and confirm the pod is scheduled onto a matching node using "kubectl get pod -o wide".

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
